notes.title: Major Visual Upgrades & Tobacco Prep Overhaul! 🔧
notes.content:
Hey, guys! After some time we are getting back to you with new news, we have given ourselves quite a lot of work over the last month with visual upgrades and progress, so let's see what's new.

[h2]🔪Tobacco preparation [/h2]
As we stated in the previous newsletter, we are working on the tobacco. We weren't completely happy with our first demo, so we wanted to improve it both [b]visually and mechanically[/b]. 

One of the first things we wanted to change was the [b]visual of the tobacco[/b], we were not happy with the way it looked. [b]Kay, our graphic designer, went to great lengths to create different visuals that have the ability to recolor, have custom particles and help maintain that visual consistency.[/b] We currently have 3 stages, [b]raw, coarse and fine[/b], which each have their own visual.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/5b28420df4f53780a3350c85fb1eef3bb81d43f6.png[/img]

For me, the challenge again was to program it and design the interaction to make it friendly for you, the player. In the end, [b]we came to the conclusion that the pad will be your workstation[/b], where you prepare the tobacco, mix it and later load in. All of these things will happen at board level.

[i]😴 BEFORE:[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/f5322560ab2cfd4214d1ff7905fb43ca498cd09c.gif[/img]

[i]🥳 AFTER: [/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/c091367b1d7424e1b8bf2811fa2d45ee32d861e5.gif[/img]


[h2]📦 Storage room [/h2]
Every business needs a place to store things. We already had this place set up, but something was missing... variation! Besides having our heads buried in tobacco, we started looking at our storage system and how to give it a similar personalization method to the rest of the hookah lounge.

The warehouse is more about functionality, so we looked at [b]expanding the types of shelving[/b]. Right now you'll be able to stack your warehouse with a[b] classic rack, a box slide, a small item rack, or shelves[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/016ef253187e07e186a8aa1e8b07b0620eec47b3.png[/img]

As you buy boxes of tobacco, raw materials, boxes of furniture you don't want to sell yet, this variation will come in handy. 

[h2] 👀 What to expect next? [/h2]
Sometimes it seems to be going at a snail's pace, but we are extremely happy and thankful that we are still getting wishlists and interest in our game. We're working on it with 3 people in our spare time, so it means a lot to us.

We'd like to finish the delivery system we've been using since last time, the warehouse, and move the tobacco preparation to the tobacco loading job.

Adam

notes.title: Breathe Easy! Ventilation, Traffic & Special Ramadan Event!
notes.content:
Hello! We're reporting back to you after two weeks with some new stuff we're working on. I won't drag this out - let's see what we're working on.

[h2]☁️ Ventilation and fume[/h2]
We want the environment of your lounge to be [b]dynamic [/b]- this of course includes the[b] smoke and its ventilation[/b]! At the base you'll have a classic air conditioning system, but you'll be able to upgrade over time. 

Depending on the amount of clutter in the air (from shisha, coals etc.), the smoke will gradually appear and thus affect your customers. [b]We're really looking forward to showing you all of this interconnected[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/9508f4253592774bda228e6074c8e1b150603b2a.gif[/img]

[h2]🚗 Traffic simulation[/h2]
Last week we started working on the traffic system in the outdoor environment.[b] We'll be fine-tuning the animations and visuals over the next two weeks, but the basics are done.[/b] If you enter the roadway, the car will of course slow down, but we don't promise in high speeds that nothing will happen. 👀

[b]This wont be only a visual gimmic - we need some traffic for gameplay hehe.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/832e301ce90a76bae3206a56ec9c195d9a467fad.gif[/img]

[h2]🌙 Welcome Ramadan![/h2]
Because we would like our game to be seen by many enthusiasts, we joined the Days of Ramadan event! [b]We would love to welcome you new pipers and look forward to having you play our game![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/f725bf031463e28d284f750af0255101322f0b80.png[/img]

[h2]🗺️ Localization system[/h2]
Just like the last news save system we have a new back bone system and that is localization! [b]We can make sure that in the available languages you see on Steam, all the text will be translated and you will be able to change the language within a game session if you prefer another.[/b] 💪

We can see what we have for wishlists and interest, but if you want to make sure you have your native language translated as well, drop us a line on discord!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/66dbb92c7e7e7ddec969b69fe579ae7569eaa5bc.png[/img]

[h2]👀 What to expect next? [/h2]
We want the core of our game to be as good as possible, so it needs a lot of iterations.[b] We are currently continuing to improve the visualizations of tobacco, its manipulation and embers, here are some pictures of the things we are working on.[/b]

Apart from the tobacco system[b] I'll be happy to show you our delivery system next news[/b] which I have in progress. We have some minor features in there, but you'll see them later.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/64773c4585ee505a17e544f7df03d4a8806b2bae.png[/img]

Thanks to all the people who continue to wishlist our game, you can reach us on discord and looking forward to next updates in two weeks!

Adam

notes.title: Silence Broken: Exciting News & Regular Updates Incoming
notes.content:
Hey, guys! It's been quiet for a while with no news, but the quiet period has passed and we have another batch of news! 

And it won't be the only one, we're a small team that makes the game in our spare time, but we've currently changed the way we operate to release [b]news on a bi-weekly basis[/b]. That's great, right?

[h2]🤫 Why have we been quiet for so long?[/h2]
We had a month after the Czech Games Week to prepare the game to a presentable state for the developer conference, where the first feedback was given.

After the conference [b]we had a lot of modifications on the project's code[/b], we want to gradually improve these things and continue to announce them to you via these communication channels ([url=https://discord.gg/9M9nnKk4T9]Discord [/url]💙).

[h2]🧒 Our first conference[/h2]
A few of you from our local pond had a chance to meet us at the GDS - developer conference in Prague, and we'd like to [b]welcome all the readers who came to say hello![/b] 👋

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/ce7b09391a06773836b37d6d88ef5895ce518086.png[/img]

There [b]we showcased the first demo of our game[/b] to test interactions, game feel, etc. We [b]implemented this feedback[/b] over the last months and had to change some of our core systems - primarily the controls to make it enjoyable for you - players.

[b]The event was great and we are already planning to show up again with another version of the game![/b]

[h2]💾 Save System [/h2]
One of the biggies and under the hood features was the [b]save system[/b]. Every game needs to save its states so that the player can continue his journey. We've added this system to the game, allowing for[b] periodic automatic saves[/b], manual saves, [b]overwriting saves[/b], pretty much everything a player would expect from it. 

And the bonus?[b] It's ready to sync with Steam[/b], so you'll have your saves available when you uninstall or play the game on multiple devices.


[h2]🚪 End of the day [/h2]
We would like to introduce you to the end of the daily cycle. You as a player [b]will be able to choose when you open and close the business[/b] with closing the door and turning of the sign. You won't be able to be open 24/7, but you will have almost full control over the time your hookah lounge opens! 💨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/8ca16d813b4b1159d84824861a7519adc959f612.gif[/img]

If you want to close before a given smoke shop the[b] game will alert you[/b] before you move on to the next day. You'll also see stats when you finish, but we'll show you those in a later devblogs. 😌


[h2]👀 What to expect next? [/h2]
At the moment we have a few things in the works, but the next news will focus on one of the main things in the game - [b]tobacco preparation[/b]. Here's a little tease (still work in progress) 🔪

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/f5322560ab2cfd4214d1ff7905fb43ca498cd09c.gif[/img]

[b]I look forward to telling you about the other features we are working on. If you have any questions, comments, or ideas on what to add to the game, we'd love to see you on our [url=https://discord.gg/9M9nnKk4T9]Discord[/url]![/b]

Adam

notes.title: A bunch of news, an event, a developer video?
notes.content:
Our embers have not been extinguished and we are still intensively developing all the planned features. Are you well? Well, now you'll feel even better. This is all we've added, here we go!

[h2]🫂 It's getting crowded. [/h2]
[b]With the demo deadline approaching[/b] (👀), we're looking into you - our customers! We're slowly finishing their visual representation, and we'll add a few more animation states. The navigation loop is ready (But they still have to learn to walk, atleast visually hehe).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/f8a3dd718947da45351767243906cdcf5fb25374.gif[/img]

[h2]🏠 So, where are we exactly? [/h2]
A few observant people have already started pointing out that it is possible that this shisha lounge is located somewhere, so can you tell by the outdoor environment where we are exactly? 😏

Our lead designer Kay took great care in capturing the particular place. You'll be able to move around there day and night, picking up deliveries and taking care of your business logistically.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/94a736946b1460c7b296f80615d9be57d995c6b8.png[/img]

[h2]💬 Hi, what can I get you? [/h2]
We are also getting closer to showing the full ordering functionality. During this period, we have focused on improving the communication between the customer and you - the player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/a284d22a713cd4cbef10f069349a1ed8f4218c49.gif[/img]

The customer also needs to let the player know how they feel and what they need, so [b]we are introducing our moodlet implementation![/b] 😊 In addition to the shisha requests, the customer will also show their mood, indicating if you've done them any harm or if they are fully satisfied.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/01a6e186ec819ae73a4ea3596f6ff16805a647fb.png[/img]

[h2]🔥 Another step of coal mechanic... heating up[/h2]
Last time we showed you how to operate the coals, today we can [b]heat them up![/b] For the demonstrations we have sped up the process, but if the heater is turned on or off the coals cool down, just like when removed. Their temperature can significantly affect the quality and duration of the hookah.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/27d7433aba1964fbb3297f4e9c3686bff3b1ac58.gif[/img]

[h2] 🇨🇿 CZ&SK GAMES WEEK 🇸🇰[/h2]
[b]Since we are a mix of Czech and Slovak developers, we are participating in CZ&SK GAMES WEEK![/b] In addition to the promos from the Steam side, we will have a developer talk with some game footage on Thursday, November 14 at 18:00 CET. You are all invited!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188121/51730d21f9559040200346c0f627a099f9770c35.png[/img]

That'll be all for now! We'll be glad if you join our discord, we look forward to more news!
Adam
